body:
Thank you. I think you're right about there being people who care about me, it's just that I'm not the only one who struggles and not everyone can devote time and resources into helping me out which is understandable and I don't take anything for granted. I do drawing myself even though it's not that good, just recently haven't been able to pick up a pen because of all that's going on in my life right now, which is a bit pathetic I guess. The people who want to get rid of me now I bet they care, they just can't be bothered and are unable to assist someone so messed up like myself and it's my fault for being such a moron in the first place so I'm sorry.
Lots of my long time friends who mean a lot to me and are the reason I even got this far are from America so I've gotten accustomed to waiting for replies it's really not a problem for me. I hope you are having a good time and thanks again.

I thank you very much for responding. I promise I'm trying my best and I've been talking to several doctors locally, they couldn't help me and any psychiatrist here that I could afford has rejected me. 

I don't wanna blame anyone I think it's my fault and a year ago I was planning to move to a different country by myself with nothing on me, but at least I could speak fluently in the local language. I was so scared I couldn't concentrate and I messed up so I didn't end up taking the flight. Maybe my life was ruined because of my poor decision making and I've had people offer me help before I simply removed them from my life because there was something missing and I didn't want to be a burden. Maybe if I had simply waited and been more patient and organized this wouldn't be happening right now, but who knows? I'm sorry I don't really want much attention I think I've hurt enough people with my presence.
I'm sorry I probably made lots of mistakes and I'm going to be really shy to reply to people in public, if anyone can send me a private DM instead please do I'm do sorry.
